title: Howard Hughes and the 'Mormon mafia'
summary: Matthew Pines tells of Howard Hughes and the 'Mormon mafia', about 1950s-1970s at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: Matthew Pines, a security analyst, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that Howard Hughes, the rich American aviator and businessman, was closely tied to the Mormon church from the 1950s to the 1970s. He says the senior managers and handlers who ran Hughes's business empire were nearly all Mormons, a group people called "the Mormon mafia." He brings it up as part of a picture in which a small, close-knit circle ran private aerospace work linked to secret programmes.
